div.div: حَوًى , (Az, IB, TA,) or ↓ حَوِيَّةٌ , (K,) The having, or assuming, a round, or circular, or coiled, form; or roundness or circularity [or the state of being coiled]; of anything; (Az, K, TA;) as, for instance, of a serpent; (Az, IB, TA;) and of certain asterisms, which appear regularly disposed in a round, or circular, form. (Az, TA.) [See 5.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
